svg.title: Make the Relationship Clear and the Claims Supportable
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-disclosure-and-claims-readiness; chapter number: 12; title: Make the Relationship Clear and the Claims Supportable; subtitle: Sequence disclosure placement, presentation checks, claim evidence, and brand-name advertising inspection.; caption: Erika Kullberg, Michael Ostheimer, Carmen, Cohen at AM Days, Gordon at Venable LLP, Analytics Playbook, and Grow My Ads provide the readiness checks.; assumptions note: The weekly slots organize checks described by Erika Kullberg, Michael Ostheimer, AM Days, Venable LLP, Analytics Playbook, and Grow My Ads. They are planning slots, not practitioner claims about task duration or a grace period for disclosure.; note: Michael Ostheimer says disclosures must work on smartphones and match visual or audible claims. Carmen says account-level disclosure does not replace disclosure on individual posts.; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Place relationship explanations; deliverable: Put commission language beside affiliate links, as Erika Kullberg demonstrates. Michael Ostheimer identifies 'paid link' as a compact option; Carmen also discloses on individual affiliate posts.; gate: The connection is visible beside the recommendation, not left solely to an account-level statement.; week: Week 2; title: Check mobile and media presentation; deliverable: Inspect the smartphone presentation and match visual and audible disclosures to the endorsement, following Michael Ostheimer. Identify each free-product connection as Erika Kullberg recommends.; gate: The disclosure remains clear on the phone and in the relevant visual or audio presentation.; week: Week 3; title: Substantiate product and earnings claims; deliverable: Check testimonials, before-and-after images, and product claims against supporting evidence, following Cohen at AM Days. Apply Gordon's Venable LLP warning about earnings-result tracking and easy-money claims.; gate: Do not rely on advertiser copy as proof; remove claims that everyone makes money or that the process is easy.; week: Week 4; title: Inspect visible brand-name advertising; deliverable: Follow Analytics Playbook by avoiding dynamic keyword insertion and disabling automatically created assets in competitor campaigns. Inspect dynamic search advertising for the name-insertion problem reported by Grow My Ads.; gate: Inspect actual visible copy for unintended competitor names rather than assuming keyword selection and published wording are the same.
